tasks.name: repeat_until_approved
tasks.details: Loop until workflow variable approved is true.

tasks.name: upload_schema
tasks.details: Collect or upload schema changes for the current iteration.

tasks.name: my_fork_join_ref
tasks.details: Run Review1.a and Review1.b in parallel.

tasks.name: Review1.a
tasks.details: First reviewer in the primary review stage.

tasks.name: Review1.b
tasks.details: Second reviewer in the primary review stage.

tasks.name: notification_join_ref
tasks.details: Join for Review1.a and Review1.b before switch.

tasks.name: Review1Check
tasks.details: Check if both Review1 approvals were granted.

tasks.name: Review2Check
tasks.details: Determine whether Review3 is required based on Review2.

tasks.name: Review3
tasks.details: Tertiary review if Review2 requires it.

tasks.name: CompleteReview_1
tasks.details: Complete review when Review3 is skipped.

control_flow_patterns.loop: DO_WHILE loop that repeats until approved variable is set to true.
control_flow_patterns.parallel: FORK_JOIN for Review1.a and Review1.b followed by JOIN.
control_flow_patterns.conditional: SWITCH tasks gate later review stages and determine completion path.

data_flow.approvals: Review results feed into switch cases using user_action.output.approved placeholder.
data_flow.loop_state: Loop condition depends on approval outcome of each iteration.

external_interactions.human_interaction: Implied by approval checks; to be implemented with activities producing review decisions.
